raw_text:
PLAN "Upper Body Strength, Cardio, Mobility & Body Recomposition for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper body strength in pain-free range"
  GOAL secondary body_recomposition:
    name "Body recomposition: fat loss, muscle gain"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Cardiovascular endurance for long climbing days"
  GOAL secondary climbing_specific:
    name "Climbing-specific grip and core prep"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Upper body and shoulder mobility"

SUMMARY
  duration: 12 weeks
  frequency: 4 sessions/week (Mon, Wed, Thu, Sat)
  structure:
    - 2x upper body strength + mobility (Mon, Thu)
    - 1x cardio + mobility (Wed)
    - 1x full body fun finisher (Sat, includes mobility)
    - Cardio and climbing-specific prep progress in later phases
    - Mobility work included in every session
    - Nutrition plan for body recomposition
    - Phase 3 peaks intensity for climbing trip

  equipment_required:
    - full gym (barbell, dumbbells, cable machine, bench, rower, bike, hangboard, mats, step/box)

  contraindications_respected:
    - No overhead loading or exercises outside pain-free range for right shoulder
    - No jumping or plyometrics
    - All mobility and strength work adapted for shoulder impingement

  progression:
    - Phase 1: Foundation (build base strength, introduce mobility, moderate cardio)
    - Phase 2: Progression (increase intensity/volume, add hangboard prep, longer cardio)
    - Phase 3: Climbing Prep & Peak (high intensity, climbing-specific grip/core, peak for trip, deload in final week)

  key_focus:
    - Horizontal pressing/pulling
    - Grip/core for climbing
    - Full body functional finishers
    - Mobility for shoulder health
    - Endurance for long climbing days
    - Nutrition for fat loss and muscle gain

NUTRITION
  STRATEGY body_recomposition:
    calories: moderate_deficit
    protein: 1.6..2.2 g/kg
    carbs: moderate
    fats: moderate
    meals_per_day: 3..5
    hydration: 2.5L
    notes: "Prioritize lean protein (chicken, fish, tofu, eggs, Greek yogurt), whole grains, fruits, vegetables, healthy fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts). Time protein intake evenly across meals. Pre- and post-workout meals should include protein and carbs. Limit processed foods and added sugars. Adjust calories based on progress every 4 weeks."
